findings.title: Internal platform login is reachable
findings.evidence:
Port 8080/tcp redirects to /login and has the title Principal Internal Platform - Login
Requested resource was /login.
findings.remediation: Confirm the platform is only reachable from trusted networks and protected by strong authentication.

findings.title: Proxy-like behavior detected
findings.evidence: The http-open-proxy script reports that the proxy might be redirecting requests.
findings.remediation: Verify the service is not operating as an unintended open proxy and restrict proxy behavior where possible.

findings.title: SSH is exposed
findings.evidence: Port 22/tcp is open and identified as OpenSSH 9.6p1 Ubuntu 3ubuntu13.14.
findings.remediation: Limit SSH access to trusted sources and enforce key-based authentication.

summary.executive: Scan covers 1 host exposing 2 open service(s). No hosts are directly internet-exposed. No high-risk services were observed. 3 finding(s) were generated from the scan.
remediation: Confirm the platform is only reachable from trusted networks and protected by strong authentication.
Verify the service is not operating as an unintended open proxy and restrict proxy behavior where possible.
Limit SSH access to trusted sources and enforce key-based authentication.
